latency_endpoint: Median candidate minus baseline wall seconds for the same questions completed by both. Keep all first attempts in quality, and report a sensitivity scoped only by prespecified execution errors.
readiness_endpoint: Ready per planned, at least 90% and at least the same-batch baseline; report paired regressions
misleading_endpoint: Observed misleading per completed, with zero as the target
acceptance_endpoint: C3 full credit per planned question
condition_endpoint: C2 full credit per planned question
